name: MySQL
note: MySQL writes its error log as `<host name>.err` in its data folder, not in `/opt/homebrew/var/log`.

storage.name: MySQL data
storage.note: The MySQL data folder also holds the binary logs.

storage.removal: `PURGE BINARY LOGS` in MySQL after review
storage.note: `PURGE BINARY LOGS` removed the older binary logs. The test table kept its rows. Binary logs can be necessary for replication and for recovery to a point in time.
